scripture.verse: "That He would grant you, according to the riches of His glory, to be strengthened with might by His Spirit in the inner man; that Christ may dwell in your hearts by faith; that you, being rooted and grounded in love, may be able to comprehend with all saints what is the breadth, and length, and depth, and height; and to know the love of Christ, which passes knowledge, that you might be filled with all the fullness of God."

sermons.title: Sermon 708 | The Blood Of Abel And The Blood Of Jesus

scripture.verse: "And He said, 'Whathave you done? The voice of your brother's blood cries unto Me from the ground.'"
"It is hard for you to kick against the pricks."
"And I saw a great white throne, and Him that sat on it, from whose face the earth and the Heaven fled away. And there was found no place for them."
"This also comes forth from the Lord of Hosts, Who is wonderful in counsel and excellent in working."
"Then came Amalek, and fought with Israel in Rephidim."
"Deliver me from the guilt of bloodshed, O God, The God of my salvation, And my tongue shall sing aloud of Your righteousness."

sermons.title: Sermon 714 | A Savior Such As You Need

scripture.verse: "But the Holy Spirit also witnesses to us: for after He had said before, This is the covenant thatI willmake with them after those days, says the Lord, I will put My laws into their hearts, and in their minds will I write them, then He adds, Their sins and iniquities I will remember no more. Now where there is remission of these, there is no longer an offering for sin."

sermons.title: Sermon 715 | Children's Bread Given To Dogs

scripture.verse: "And she said, Truth, Lord: yet even the little dogs eat of the crumbs which fall from their masters' table."
